sloka: उपस्थापयत क्षिप्रम् शिबिकाम् मम वानराः ।श्रुत्वा तु वचनम् तस्य हरयः शीघ्र विक्रमाः ॥४-३८-९॥
transliteration: upasthāpayata kṣipram śibikām mama vānarāḥ ।śrutvā tu vacanam tasya harayaḥ śīghra vikramāḥ ॥4-38-9॥

translations.english: On hearing the king, the monkeys who were quick to act placed a beautiful palanquin in front of him.
